verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for a SaaS platform with a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents API access tokens, flag version rollback and SDK version numbers, but none of these is API versioning or a published deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and nothing in the pack describes API version headers, version lifecycles or deprecation timelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
